rat_sinew.name: Rat Sinew
rat_sinew.desc: A pale length of sinew from a Greenmoor rat, stained faintly green and smelling of bad water. Tough, though.

blightmothers_venom_sac.name: The Blightmother's Venom Sac
blightmothers_venom_sac.desc: Swollen, warm, and still dripping. The same sourness Merrick tastes in the water, straight from its source.

blight_heart.name: Blight Heart
blight_heart.desc: The Blightmother's rotten heart, still twitching. Whatever smothered the spring crystal, it beat in here.

vial_of_spring_water.name: Vial of Spring Water
vial_of_spring_water.desc: Drawn from the Wellspring after the crystal was freed: clear, cold and clean. Proof the spring runs pure again.

leatherwing_charm.name: Leatherwing Charm
leatherwing_charm.desc: A bat's claw on a thong, taken from the oldest thing that hangs in the Wellspring's dark.
